tools.name: search_setups
tools.description: Find AI setups for a job, such as "chase late invoices" or "reply to Google reviews". Returns the best matches with Tested setups ranked first, each with its page link.

tools.name: get_setup
tools.description: The full setup for a slug from search_setups: who it is for, steps, the copy-paste prompt, common snags, sources, and its label (tested or researched).

tools.name: get_skill
tools.description: The SKILL.md for a setup, ready to save as ~/.claude/skills/<name>/SKILL.md, plus the .zip link for the Claude app. Only setups with a skill have one.
